MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000318
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
D.OCKET NO. F00444623
CITIZENS BANK, N.A., is the Plaintiff, and ELINES SANCHEZ PABON, ET ALS., are Defendants.
writ of execution for the sale of
mortgaged premises dated
01/28/2026.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered. I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 22ND DAY of
APRIL A.D. 2026, at the hour of one
thirty o' clock by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
Property to be sold is located in the
TOWNSHIP OF WOODBRIDGE,
County of Middlesex and State of
New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 42 HARROW
DRIVE, COLONIA, NEW JERSEY 07067.
Tax Lot: 3, Tax Block: 476.06.
Dimensions of Lot: (Approximately):
155' X 296'
Nearest Cross Street: NEW DOVER ROAD.
Approx Upset Price: $1,182,000.00.
Property Status: Borrower Occupied.
*SUBJECT TO ANY UNPAID TAXES,
MUNICIPAL LIENS OR OTHER
CHARGES, AND ANY SUCH TAXES,
CHARGES, LIENS, INSURANCE
PREMIUMS OR OTHER ADVANCES
MADE BY PLAINTIFF PRIOR TO THIS SALE.
THE AMOUNT DUE CAN BE
OBTAINED FROM THE LOCAL
TAXING AUTHORITY. PURSUANT TO
NJSA 46:8B-21 THE SALE MAY ALSO
BE SUBJECT TO THE LIMITED LIEN
PRIORITY OF ANY CONDOMINIUM/HOMEROWNERS ASSOCIATION LIENS WHICH MAY EXIST.
ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO
CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR
OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST
REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE
PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING
FORECLOSED AND, IF SO THE
CURRENT AMOUNT DUE THEREON.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of NINE HUNDRED TWENTY
FOUR THOUSAND SEVEN HUNDRED
SIXTY TWO DOLLARS AND TWENTY
EIGHT CENTS ($924,762.28) dollars
more or less, plus interest together
with the costs of this sale. THE
UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT
TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrietions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
McCabe, Weisberg & Conway LLC
216 Haddon Avenue, Suite 201
Westmont, NJ 08108
Attorneys
Dated: 3/24, 3/31, 4/7, 4/14/2026
